2: For the music director, according to Do Not Destroy. Of David. A miktam. When Saul dispatched men and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God. Protect me from those who rise up against me.
3: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and from men of bloodshed save me.
4: For look, they lie in wait for my life. The mighty attack against me, not because of my transgression or my sin, O Yahweh.
5: Without guilt on my part they run and ready themselves. Awake to meet me and see.
6: And you, Yahweh, God of hosts, are the God of Israel. Rouse yourself to punish all the nations. Do not be gracious to any who treacherously plot evil. Selah
7: They return at evening; they howl like dogs while they prowl the city.
8: Look, they pour out talk with their mouth. Swords are on their lips, for they say, “Who hears?”
9: But you, O Yahweh, will laugh at them; you will mock all the nations.
10: O my strength, I will watch for you, because you, O God, are my (high) stronghold.
11: My God of loyal love will meet me; God will cause me to look in triumph on my enemies.
12: Do not kill them, lest my people forget. Make them to wander by your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
13: By the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips, even in their pride, let them be trapped, and for the curses and lies they proclaim.
14: Destroy in anger; destroy so they are no more, so that they may know that God is ruling in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah
15: They return at evening; they howl like dogs while they prowl the city.
16: As for them, they wander for food. If they are not satisfied, then they continue all night.
17: But as for me, I will sing of your strength, and I will hail your loyal love in the morning, because you have been my high stronghold and a refuge in my ⌞time⌟ of trouble.
18: O my strength, to you I will give praise, because God is my high stronghold, my God of loyal love.
